definition.theta_definition: Load direction relative to the reference fibre family. The fixed global X loading axis therefore uses geometry(theta_deg=-theta). No angle-symmetry reduction is assumed.

geometry.theta_definition: Weave rotation relative to the fixed x uniaxial loading axis
geometry.fracture_length_note: The fixed geometric length is the fibre diameter. particle_spacing_equivalent_m is only a sampling diagnostic. Neither is assigned to a constitutive crack-band length; the solver must choose and report that length separately, for example from grid support.
geometry.sampling: Uniform centreline arclength and equal-area circular rings. Angular quantiles use the tube Jacobian 1-curvature*r*cos(angle); each particle carries an equal share of the analytic circular-tube volume within its fibre. Arclength uses composite eight-point Gauss quadrature.
geometry.end_caps: Centreline clipped to the nominal rectangle inset by radius, with circular caps normal to the local tangent. Corner remnants shorter than four diameters in planar line parameter are omitted.
geometry.coupling_requirement: Independent per-fibre velocity fields and explicit contact. Scattering these IDs onto one shared velocity field would impose bonding and is not the intended model.
geometry.centreline_sampling: Per-fibre endpoint-inclusive samples with planar parameter spacing no larger than pitch/32; centreline() is the analytic audit reference.
geometry.contact_candidate_scope: One reference search seed per retained planar crossing, with analytic curved-centreline refinement and circular surface offsets. If the refined location lies past a trimmed endpoint, the exact over/under crossing is retained as the seed instead. These are not initially active contacts or a complete candidate list after finite sliding. Update or expand the search from deformed positions; do not preserve normals or gaps as kinematic constraints.

clearance_validation.basis: All three crossing-family pairs and both line-index parities. At a planar crossing the separation is 2*crimp, so any closer pair lies within 2*crimp/sin(60deg) of that crossing in each line parameter. Segment distances are exact; two analytic sinusoid interpolation bounds are subtracted. Parallel-family centreline distance is at least pitch. A fibre is a sinusoidal graph with a constant binormal; radius*maximum_curvature<1 keeps its offset graphs monotone and ordered, avoiding self-intersection. The periodic weave translates by (2*pitch/sqrt(3),0) and (pitch/sqrt(3),pitch).

symmetry_validation.angle_interval_condition: Only for identical fibres and contact laws with loading, grips and external fields invariant under thickness turnover. XZ is the weave plane and Y is thickness. The reflection used is (x,y,z)->(x,-y,-z); a planar reflection without reversing over/under is not asserted. One-sided contact or a substrate invalidates this reduction.

sampling_parameters.packing_scope: Sampling-density multiplier only; not a fibre volume fraction, physical packing change or constitutive characteristic length.

fracture_length.scope: h=grid dx, independent of particle spacing and sampling packing; h < 2*E*Gf/ft^2.

grid.budget_scope: max_nodes limits dense AABB addressing, including when grid_storage=tube. It is not an active-node or process-memory limit.
grid.memory_note: Seven grid scalars are a storage subtotal, not a peak-memory prediction. Particle stencils, constitutive temporaries, contact search, compiled executables and checkpoints require additional memory.
grid.node_count_scope: Dense AABB upper bound; actual active nodes are constructed and validated at runtime.

definition.interpretation: An explicit dynamic finite coupon with 10 gauge-length elastic transit times of loading and a 20% hold. Kinetic/elastic energy ratio is recorded, not assumed negligible. First material failure, dynamic reaction maximum and sampled section-graph connectivity are distinct observations; they do not by themselves define a quasi-static or size-converged failure envelope.

contact_regions.scope: One local circular Hertz force per connected active finite-segment region. Distinct regions on one fibre pair are independent; this is a discrete contact approximation, not an exact curved-surface solution. Adhesive branch merge/split is unsupported.

contact_model.centreline: Current mass-weighted cross-section centroids with piecewise linear interpolation.
contact_model.radius: Fixed reference circular radii; only small cross-sectional strain is represented.
contact_model.curvature: Two projected cylinder curvature tensors; R_eff is the inverse square root of their summed determinant. Orthogonal equal cylinders give R_eff=R, not R/2. This circular replacement is not an exact elliptical JKR solution.
contact_model.energy: Normal force is the fixed-curvature indentation derivative. Curvature changes do not include their geometric work term, so global contact-energy conservation is not asserted.
contact_model.coverage: Every reference capsule within the recorded motion skin is audited at each accepted step. Discrete active cells are grouped by eight-neighbour connectivity on each fibre pair; each component contributes one local Hertz force.
contact_model.limits: Stateless Hertz only, no adhesive branch merge/split. Fixed circular radii and a circular equivalent-curvature approximation. Failed-section, physical endpoint, same-family/degenerate geometry, exhausted motion skin, overlapping local patches or component-budget overflow require rejection.

contact_regions.scope: One local circular Hertz force per connected active finite-segment region. Distinct regions on one fibre pair are independent; this is a discrete contact approximation, not an exact curved-surface solution. Adhesive branch merge/split is unsupported.

graph_scope: Section graph: adjacent occupied sections within each fibre plus active contact edges. Its connectivity is an approximation, not an exact 3D MPM support graph. Positive-weight x-node interval cuts are separately reconstructed and are only a sufficient axial-disconnection diagnostic.
peak_scope: Partial or probe force maximum; not an accepted macroscopic failure load.
work_scope: Actual clamp work sums each step's group impulse dotted with the prescribed fixture velocity. Core boundary_work is separately reported as a grid kinetic-energy correction. Dynamic contact curvature work and snap dissipation are not fully represented.
kinetic_energy_scope: Particle translation plus the quadratic-APIC affine term dx^2/8 times sum(mass*Frobenius_norm(C)^2); both components are also saved separately.

layout.scope: Storage compression only; absent tube support invalidates a step. Material length, physical grid phase and particle discretization are unchanged.
layout.dilation: Three axis-separable maximum filters of width 2*padding+1 on reference quadratic stencil occupancy, intersected with the original dense fibre AABB.
